study: Garet et al. 2016, Content-Intensive Math PD (Intel Math) (NCEE 2016-4010)
eval_evidence: IES/NCEE-commissioned RCT conducted by AIR; evaluators are independent of the Intel Math / MLC program developers.
developer_evidence: Intel Math delivered by experienced external Intel Math instructors; the Mathematics Learning Community and Video Feedback Cycles delivered by trained, district-based facilitators (intermediaries), not by the research/evaluation team.
cascade_evidence: MLC sessions and the video-feedback coaching were delivered by district-based facilitators who were trained to deliver them (train-the-trainer hop between program and classroom teachers).
counterfactual_evidence: Within-school RCT; control grade-4 teachers continued business-as-usual instruction and PD.
coaching_evidence: Coaching = three individualized Video Feedback Cycles (~3 hrs total) based on video excerpts of teachers' lessons during 2013-14; light/periodic, video-based rather than recurring live in-class cycles.
student_dose_evidence: Intervention changes the grade-4 teacher's math instruction only; no student tutoring, pull-out, or added dose.
maturity_evidence: All PD (80-hr summer Intel Math + MLC + video cycles) delivered in a single year (summer 2013 + 2013-14); outcomes measured spring 2014, the first/only implementation year.
